title: sebastiania corniculata var. longifolia
intro: Sebastiania corniculata var. longifolia, commonly known as Longifolia, is a plant species within the Euphorbiaceae family. It is known for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional medicine, where it is used to treat various health conditions. The plant is reported to have health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, making it a potential therapeutic option for wound healing and infections. The bioactive constituents of Longifolia include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities.
